Hey let me ask you one thing before you get started, are any of the ahead changes you see needing to hit world_loader.zig? if so, then how you should proceed is to instrument it into the latest landing commits - 84460c9cd — framework loader split
  - 1630a540e — geometry parity tests so that we arnt going to be updating old code
resolution: Audited prospective event architecture against the landed world-loader split. No code is required for the current classification pass. Future implementation has narrow split-loader touchpoints for native Map Paint and play interactions; all work must target framework/world_loader.zig plus framework/world_loader/* from 84460c9cd, preserve geometry parity from 1630a540e, and never update the legacy repository-root world_loader.zig.
